headline: Last session: Sensex plunges 989 points and Nifty slips to 25,600 as bears take control

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 30 November.

why: Bears tightened their grip on the market, dragging the Sensex down by nearly 989 points.
Brent crude oil prices topped $97, putting pressure on market sentiment and snapping mid-week recovery.
IT stocks experienced heavy selling pressure and dragged the benchmark indices lower.
Federal Reserve rate-hike risks lingered globally, creating uncertainty across equity markets.
whatHappening: Nifty 50 slipped below the 25,650 level to close around 25,600 in the last trading session.
Metal stocks managed to outperform the broader market despite heavy selling in IT.
Bombay High Court granted approval for the Tata Sons board meeting scheduled for November 30.
Gold rebounded from 15-month lows while silver prices surged nearly 6%.
summary: On the last trading session, Indian equities faced intense selling pressure as Sensex plunged 989 points. The downturn was driven by drag in IT stocks and rising Brent crude oil prices topping $97. Markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 30 November.
